name: Red Snow
source:
A strange, inexplicable phenomenon strikes a small town. Red snow falls on the town, turning the streets and the sky a blood-red color. Shortly afterward, children and teenagers begin to disappear, causing panic in the town until the snow melts away. 

Dante is a teenager known in his town for being a troublemaker,  When the red snow fell, his boyfriend Johnny disappeared. Several years later, now 19 years old, in the middle of a snowstorm on his way to school, he runs into his boyfriend again. As a result, the town leaves it up to these two boys to try to solve the mystery.
